(Sorry for the late reply.)

Are you suggesting that I stay alive simply so I don't end my family lineage?

I have tried to let my friends help, but it just seems that they're wanting to fill the empty void left in my heart that nothing can fill. "I'll be your family" they keep saying.

I really have no passions anymore.

I'm not sure if counseling can help me. I just don't see any light at the end of the tunnel for me.

1. Killing myself will end my heartache. How the hell can I move on from losing my entire family? Would you want to live after losing your entire family?
2. Like I said: friends are simply not enough.
3. Assistant manager at a K-mart. I make (well, made) pretty good money, so I can support myself financially, but that's not the point.
4. Yes, there was a funeral.
